summary.text: Bill Bush represents District 29 in the Delaware House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: He was born in Dover, graduated from Caesar Rodney High School, earned his undergraduate degree at the University of Delaware and a law degree from Widener University's School of Law.
He practices as a private attorney and operates a small business, and previously served as a policy advisor for the Delaware Department of Safety and Homeland Security.
He has served on the Caesar Rodney School Board and the Board of Trustees of Delaware Technical Community College, and lives in the 29th District with his wife and three sons.
